pubcol-w-a0f4fde0d063e0c5.definition_en: in very good health or high spirits
pubcol-w-a0f4fde0d063e0c5.example_simple: After her holiday, she looked in the pink.
pubcol-w-a0f4fde0d063e0c5.example_complex: Despite his age, my grandfather remains in the pink, cycling several miles every morning.

pubcol-w-b7c0425ee2765000.definition_en: well known to the public and frequently seen in the media
pubcol-w-b7c0425ee2765000.example_simple: Actors are always in the public eye.
pubcol-w-b7c0425ee2765000.example_complex: Politicians who spend their careers in the public eye must accept constant scrutiny of their private lives.

pubcol-w-3d6350aad7b31917.definition_en: in a natural environment rather than in captivity
pubcol-w-3d6350aad7b31917.example_simple: These animals are rarely seen in the wild.
pubcol-w-3d6350aad7b31917.example_complex: Conservationists are working to reintroduce the endangered species into the wild after decades of captive breeding.

pubcol-w-b40b90094a0a34a9.definition_en: without success or a useful result
pubcol-w-b40b90094a0a34a9.example_simple: They searched in vain for the missing keys.
pubcol-w-b40b90094a0a34a9.example_complex: All her efforts to save the failing business proved in vain, and it closed within a year.

pubcol-w-8d385a486e6ffa36.definition_en: taking something into consideration; because of

pubcol-w-8d385a486e6ffa36.example_complex: In view of the mounting evidence against him, the defendant chose to change his plea.

pubcol-w-3bd67d7403aef19d.definition_en: paid in a series of separate payments spread over time

pubcol-w-62c5ea4b97151e54.definition_en: in a state of confusion or unable to think clearly

pubcol-w-0ac67aee50e29f3e.definition_en: consecutively, one after another without interruption
